issues.claim: §3.2 (9) (l. 3612–3615, this round) and §2.7 RaisedFoot (l. 2310–2311) hand a raised way's ring-end foot at a frame growth to 'the raised way's re-derivation', which extends the deck to the new ring and re-places both ends of that foot; §3.2 (9) also grows each raised part by (a) and (b), (a) clearing its region faces' finer content. §4.11 'The rung at an epoch' (l. 8372–8392), the epoch's one statement of what runs after the growth, names S4, S12a and the re-deriving stages of the hinterland, districts, underground, buried and dug parts, but no raised part and no raised way's re-derivation. A builder of §4.11 runs nothing there: the deck stays ending on the old raised ring while its ground end is already on part 0's new ring, and T110-2's 'after §4.11 both ends of its ring-end foot on the new rings' (l. 18219–18220) cannot pass. One-ended hook (principle (7)). §4.11 (l. 8382) and J-A81.41 also still say 'an L0 batch replacing the margin chain', against part 0's split (repair-r3-kernel.md HAND-OFFS 1–2, unwritten).
issues.required_change: (1) §4.11, l. 8392: after '`corridorUnion` (§3.7), which draws nothing' and before the closing ')', insert '; on each raised part of the ground layer §3.2 (9) grows, its raised way's re-derivation (§3.4) for that part's cleared faces, which also extends a deck ending on the old ring to the new ring and re-places both ends of that foot (§2.7 `RaisedFoot`)'. (2) §4.11, l. 8382: replace 'an L0 batch replacing the `margin` chain,' with 'an L0 batch replacing the `margin` chain (on part 0 two, a raised way's ring-end foot moved between them, §3.2 (9)),'. (3) Rationale J-A81.41: replace 'an L0 batch that replaces the margin chain' with 'an L0 batch that replaces the margin chain (on part 0 two where a raised way's foot lies at a deck end on the old ring)'.

issues.claim: §3.2 (9) (l. 3579–3583) keeps the frame or arena only 'where that is no larger'; a growth that moves a side out by no more than attractCm (26 cm) has no defined outcome. It is reachable: a frame never shrinks and grows at an upward crossing (§4.11), so a CITY made at 10 005 people that declines below 10 000 and re-crosses at 10 007 moves each frame side ≈ 17.7 cm (law 25 km² × P ÷ 20 000) and each arena side ≈ 28 cm; at CITY → METROPOLIS each person above the old peak moves a side ≈ 5 cm. Then (c)'s new rectangle has its corners within attractCm of the old ones (25.0 cm) and its sides within attractCm of the old sides, so §3.6 steps 2–3 move it onto and share the old rectangle (W_STRETCH_SHARED), and 'strips the old rectangle's border rows alike' strips the only border. Either role consistency fails and (c) is rejected with no failure class for an epoch's growth, after Plat.frame took the new frame as (b)'s last batch committed, or a border survives at the old place under a Plat.frame naming the new one. (b) behaves alike when the arena's sides move no more than attractCm. Principle (11); observed in passing by repair-r3-kernel.md.
issues.required_change: §3.2 (9), l. 3580–3581: replace 'kept at the current frame where that is no larger; the new arena is the new frame plus the current law's margin, kept at the current arena where that is no larger.' with 'kept at the current frame where that is no larger or would move any side out by at most `attractCm` ((2); measured on the lattice); the new arena is the new frame plus the current law's margin, kept at the current arena where that is no larger or would move any side out by at most `attractCm` — so no new chain is laid within attraction of the chain it replaces, which §3.6 steps 2–3 would merge into it before the strip removes its rows.'

No fixture moves a side by no more than attractCm, the edge VKr3-02 defines (principle (11): an untested edge is a major).
issues.required_change: §13.1, l. 17422: replace 'a frame growth whose frame and arena would be no larger (nothing runs)' with 'a frame growth whose frame and arena would be no larger (nothing runs), and one whose law would move a side out by at most `attractCm` — a CITY frame kept through a decline below 10 000 people, re-crossing two people above its peak (frame and arena kept, nothing runs, no chain stripped; §3.2 (9))'.

issues.claim: §2.7's RaisedFoot comment (l. 2310–2311) states a frame growth's effect on a ring-end foot as 'A frame growth (§3.2 (9)) extends the deck to the new ring as §4.11 continues a through-road, the raised way's re-derivation re-placing both ends of that foot on the new rings', and its writer list (l. 2304–2305) names the generator, the operators and the way's re-derivation. Since this round the kernel's growth itself first moves the ground end's row onto the new ring (§3.2 (9)'s foot batch), so the record's description omits a writer (principle (7)). Nothing built changes, because §3.2 (9) is explicit.
issues.required_change: §2.7, l. 2310–2311: replace 'A frame growth (§3.2 (9)) extends the deck to the new ring as §4.11 continues a through-road,' with 'A frame growth (§3.2 (9)) first moves the foot's ground end onto the new ring (its foot batch, between part 0's two L0 batches), then extends the deck to the new ring as §4.11 continues a through-road,'.
